description.id: Daftar ringkas salat sunah yang umum dikenal. Rincian pelaksanaan dapat berbeda menurut tradisi fikih.
description.en: A concise list of commonly known voluntary prayers. Details may vary across schools of jurisprudence.

description.id: Salat sunah yang mengiringi salat wajib, dikerjakan sebelum atau sesudahnya sesuai waktunya.
description.en: Voluntary prayers associated with obligatory prayers, performed before or after them at their prescribed times.

translation.id: Jumlah rakaat bergantung pada salat rawatib yang dikerjakan.
translation.en: The number of rak'ahs depends on the particular rawatib prayer.

description.id: Salat malam dengan jumlah rakaat ganjil sebagai penutup rangkaian salat malam.
description.en: A night prayer with an odd number of rak'ahs, commonly used to conclude night prayers.

context.id: Dikerjakan setelah Isya hingga sebelum Subuh.
context.en: Performed after Isha and before Fajr.

translation.en: Performed in an odd number of rak'ahs.

description.id: Salat malam yang dikerjakan setelah tidur.
description.en: A night prayer performed after sleeping.

context.id: Dikerjakan pada malam hari; sepertiga malam terakhir sering dipilih.
context.en: Performed at night; the final third of the night is often preferred.

translation.id: Dikerjakan dua rakaat demi dua rakaat.
translation.en: Performed in sets of two rak'ahs.

description.id: Salat sunah pada waktu pagi setelah matahari terbit dan meninggi.
description.en: A voluntary prayer in the morning after the sun has risen and gained height.

context.id: Dikerjakan setelah waktu terlarang seusai matahari terbit hingga sebelum Zuhur.
context.en: Performed after the prohibited period following sunrise and before Dhuhr.

translation.en: Performed with at least two rak'ahs.

description.id: Salat malam berjamaah atau sendiri pada bulan Ramadan.
description.en: Night prayer performed communally or individually during Ramadan.

context.id: Dikerjakan setelah Isya pada malam Ramadan.
context.en: Performed after Isha on Ramadan nights.

translation.id: Jumlah rakaat mengikuti praktik fikih yang dianut.
translation.en: The number of rak'ahs follows the adopted jurisprudential practice.

description.id: Salat dua rakaat sebagai penghormatan ketika memasuki masjid sebelum duduk.
description.en: A two-rak'ah prayer greeting the mosque upon entering, before sitting.

context.id: Dikerjakan ketika masuk masjid sebelum duduk, dengan memperhatikan waktu terlarang.
context.en: Performed upon entering a mosque before sitting, while observing prohibited prayer times.

description.id: Salat dua rakaat saat memohon pilihan terbaik kepada Allah dalam perkara yang dibolehkan.
description.en: A two-rak'ah prayer seeking Allah's guidance toward the best choice in a permissible matter.

translation.id: Dua rakaat, kemudian berdoa memohon petunjuk.
translation.en: Two rak'ahs, followed by a prayer for guidance.

description.id: Salat sunah ketika memohon pertolongan Allah untuk suatu kebutuhan yang baik.
description.en: A voluntary prayer when asking Allah for help with a good and lawful need.

context.id: Dikerjakan saat memiliki kebutuhan atau kesulitan.
context.en: Performed when facing a need or difficulty.

translation.id: Umumnya dikerjakan dua rakaat lalu berdoa.
translation.en: Commonly performed as two rak'ahs followed by supplication.

description.id: Salat sunah yang mengiringi penyesalan dan permohonan ampun atas dosa.
description.en: A voluntary prayer accompanying sincere remorse and a request for forgiveness.

translation.id: Dua rakaat dan dilanjutkan dengan istigfar serta tobat.
translation.en: Two rak'ahs followed by seeking forgiveness and repenting.

description.id: Salat sunah ketika terjadi gerhana matahari atau bulan.
description.en: A voluntary prayer performed during a solar or lunar eclipse.

context.en: Performed while the eclipse is occurring.

translation.id: Tata caranya memiliki rukuk dan bacaan yang lebih panjang daripada salat biasa.
translation.en: Its form includes longer recitation and bowing than an ordinary prayer.
